messages:
lina: alert: asia-east1 GPU pool failing to scale — queue depth 92, a bunch of inference requests hitting 504s and some 429s
infra-bot: [autoscaler] scaleUp request for node-group gpu-east-a queued -> api error quotaExceeded (code=429)
josh: pods pending: events show FailedScheduling -> 0/20 nodes available, insufficient gpu resources
priyanka: checking cloud console — GPU quota for project at limit in asia-east1, request to quota team made (ticket #Q-2026-118), ETA ~40m	priyanka: also seeing multiple creations stuck in PROVISIONING state, some fail with "no available internal IPs"
 taylor: can we spill traffic to us-west1 warm pool? that region had spare gpus and warm nodes earlier today
 lina: yes, recommend shifting 30% now. runbook step: use trafficctl to adjust transient weights
 taylor: command:

```
trafficctl set-weight inference-route --region asia-east1=0.70 --region us-west1=0.30
```
 josh: cluster-autoscaler logs show repeated createNode calls returning 429 or 500 from cloud API, CA backs off exponentially -> scale-up lag
 josh: CA also treats nodes in PROVISIONING as "not ready" -> some scaleDown cycles remove recently created nodes once they become NotReady/Ready toggling -> thrash
 priyanka: provisional workaround: bump gpu pool minNodes and disable aggressive scaleDown during incident
 priyanka: `gcloud container node-pools update gpu-east-a --min-nodes=6 --region=asia-east1`
 josh: also patch HPA stabilization: `kubectl patch hpa inference -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}'`
 lina: applied both; traffic shift in place; queue depth trending down, 5xxs decreasing by ~28% since shift :thumbsup:
 priyanka: raising follow-up: subnet IP exhaustion — opening infra ticket INFRA-901 to expand secondary IP range and add warm IPs for node provisioning
 priyanka: ticket link: https://redwood.internal/infra/issues/INFRA-901
 josh: root causes so far: GPU quota exhausted, subnet IP pool exhausted, and CA/backoff logic + lack of provisioning hysteresis -> scale-up lag and perceived thrash
 taylor: suggested long-term mitigations: maintain small guaranteed warm pool in critical regions, pre-allocate IP ranges, add quota monitoring alerts, and ensure CA ignores nodes stuck in PROVISIONING state for x minutes
 lina: created incident: INC-2026-0428 — autoscaler scale-up lag + provisioning errors in asia-east1
 ops-bot: Created Jira RED-INC-3001 assigned to eng-sre; links and owners added
 josh: follow-up actions: (1) add hysteresis to CA (2) add quota/IP prechecks before routing heavy traffic (3) trafficctl automation to auto-shift on scale-up latency
 priyanka: scheduled postmortem tomorrow 15:30, owners: eng-sre (lina, josh), eng-infra (priyanka), eng-runtime (taylor)
 lina: monitoring for 2h; will revert weights gradually once queues normalized
 incident-bot: incident status: mitigated (traffic shifted + minNodes bump), ongoing until postmortem
 ops-bot: closing slack thread but keeping incident open in the tracker
